surface_vocabulary.rest: visible on the one resting screen with no interaction; a fixed, non-scrolling region from the closed palette
surface_vocabulary.drill: revealed by one selection (a run/attention item) into the R4 dock, or by opening a named lens
surface_vocabulary.alert: raised as an R1 attention item on a state transition; ranked severity x actionability

rules.d1_decision: Which models may be trusted with unsupervised work at a given perturbation strength: default-route to high-Grit models and exclude low-Grit models from autonomous work.

fields_shown.where: R2 row MEASURED proof / R4c evidence rung / L-WORKFORCE

rules.action: Route: default-route to high-Grit models and exclude low-Grit models from unsupervised work (J9).
rules.d3_projection: P3 model_quality (fields also on P2 attempt_evidence)
rules.acceptance: R2 row carries a measured test verdict; L-WORKFORCE shows G(s) per model x strength; a low-Grit failure raises ON-A1.

rules.d1_decision: Whether to pay the narration tax for a task type: keep verbose reasoning only where auditability is worth the overhead, and force silent mode where it is waste.
rules.action: Intervene: set the narration/silent-inference policy for the task type (pay the tax only for auditable work).
rules.acceptance: R4d renders answer and explanation tokens as separate [data-timing] rows; L-WORKFORCE shows a per-model narration penalty with its class.

rules.d1_decision: Whether to commit to a compounding (one-way-door) architecture and how to budget the N-session cost arc before the quadratic growth locks in.
rules.action: Budget: decide the architecture on the projected N^2 curve and reserve the multi-session cost (one-way door; decision record).
rules.d3_projection: P4 story_arc + P7 spend_budget + P11 decision_ledger
rules.acceptance: L-MONEY shows the session cost arc and snowball factor with beta labeled [P]; a one-way-door decision has a receipt.

rules.d1_decision: Which energy-price scenario and hedge horizon to budget against, and the year local energy costs would flip the model/provider selection.
rules.action: Budget: pick the energy scenario and hedge horizon; recalibrate EPM for the operator's region.
rules.acceptance: The active EPM scenario and rate show beside spend, labeled [P]/[X]; switching the scenario updates the projection.

rules.d1_decision: Whether to retry, escalate, or abandon a failed attempt: price the accepted outcome, not the prompt, using the attempt ledger's first-pass and independent-evaluator verdicts.

fields_shown.where: R2 row attempt / R4c attempt boundary

rules.action: Triage/decide: on a failed verification, retry or escalate (J2/J3) and set the retry budget by accepted outcome.
rules.d3_projection: P1 workflow_records + P2 attempt_evidence + P5 run_value
rules.acceptance: A failed verification raises ON-A1 whose item opens the attempt chain with first_pass/accepted and the independent test verdict; a bounded retry action is offered.

rules.d1_decision: What fraction of jobs to run in cheaper deferred batch mode vs on-demand, trading 50% cost for a 72-hour completion horizon.
rules.action: Budget: (future) split workstreams batch vs on-demand; today a modeled scenario toggle only.
rules.acceptance: The batch panel renders measurable:false with the missing batch_mode reason, or a measured fraction once the producer lands; never a fabricated number.

rules.d1_decision: Whether to raise or lower the budget cap, and what autonomous throughput the cap buys: T_max = Budget / (cost per job x (1 + retry)).
rules.action: Decide/budget: raise or lower the budget cap (P0 raise-cap) and size autonomous throughput from the cap.
rules.acceptance: R3a shows the five money values with unknown never $0.00; a money-risk raises ON-A3 and a cap change raises ON-A4 with a signed receipt.

rules.d1_decision: Whether and how to escalate a failed attempt through model tiers (Flash -> Sonnet -> Opus -> Human), designed to keep human escalation under 1%.

fields_shown.where: R4c attempt rung (unknown until mechanism lands)

rules.action: Intervene: escalate a failed attempt to the next tier (or human) and design the cascade bound to <1% human.
rules.acceptance: An escalation event shows from->to + reason + cost, or the dock states 'no cascade armed'; E_x is labeled [C]/[X].

rules.d1_decision: What SLA buffer to set and whether to batch: never batch jobs whose SLA is under 2x observed queue depth; always keep an on-demand fallback.

fields_shown.where: R4d step timings (unknown until writer lands)

rules.action: Intervene: add an on-demand fallback and hold batch work when queue depth threatens the SLA.
rules.acceptance: R4d shows queue_wait/service_time as measured or explicit unknown; the 2x rule is computed only from measured values; a breach raises ON-A1/ON-A2.

rules.d1_decision: Which policy arm to keep, judged by outcomes per dollar (BVI = successful outcomes / (AI + human cost)) rather than by lowest cost.
rules.action: Decide/audit: compare arms on outcomes per dollar and keep the value-maximizing policy; record the verdict.
rules.d3_projection: P5 run_value + P6 arm_comparison + P7 spend_budget
rules.acceptance: L-COMPOSITION shows accepted outcomes and cost per arm with BVI (or its explicit [P] gap); a compare-arm decision has a receipt.

jobs.name: Glance
jobs.acceptance: A screenshot at 1440x900 and 390x844 contains exactly one anchor for ON-G1..G7 in its canonical region (ia.md §4).

jobs.name: Triage a stalled/failed run
jobs.acceptance: R1b carries a failure item that opens R4c with the attempt chain; the offered action is a subset of packet.safe_actions.

jobs.name: Decide approve/cancel (and promote/retire)
jobs.action: approve | promote | cancel | retire | raise-cap (P0; typed confirmation for irreversible)
jobs.acceptance: R1a shows the pending decision with its eligibility; the action set equals ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS intersect packet.safe_actions.

jobs.name: Inspect evidence and step timings
jobs.acceptance: R4c shows one [data-attempt-boundary] per attempt; R4d shows the exact timing field set with [data-state=measured|unknown]; an unknown never renders 0.

jobs.name: Watch spend
jobs.acceptance: R3a shows all five money values plus the exception marker; unknown renders as explicit unknown, never $0.00.

jobs.name: Intervene per worker/session
jobs.action: attach | detach | copy-session | steer | interrupt | stop | respawn | rm
jobs.acceptance: Each action chip carries target, authority, reversibility, confirmation, and receipt; exactly one event stream is open.

jobs.name: Audit what happened
jobs.acceptance: A decision opens a receipt; L-REGISTRY shows canonical lineage distinct from the runtime trace; recording coverage shows recorded|missing.

jobs.name: Start / enqueue work
jobs.acceptance: Unbudgeted work cannot be enqueued (admission fail-closed); the preview shows target/order/budget and returns a receipt.

jobs.name: Route / choose the model for a task
jobs.acceptance: Routing inputs show beside the run context with their evidence class; no peer routing board is required.

jobs.name: Manage background Claude sessions
jobs.action: start | stop | respawn | rm | steer | logs
jobs.acceptance: Owned actions only on OWNED sessions; daemon status is labeled; stop preserves the conversation for respawn.

jobs.name: Record / close the session
jobs.acceptance: A session close writes its record and shows a receipt; an unrecorded consequential act is surfaced as a process item in R1c.

decision_coverage.note: Every d1 operator_decision must appear in the surface map. rule_number -> surface that carries it.

1.surface: rest R2/R3c + drill L-WORKFORCE + alert ON-A1

3.decision: budget the N^2 arc / one-way door
3.surface: drill L-MONEY + alert ON-A3 + record AUDIT

5.surface: rest R1b/R2 + drill R4c/R4b + alert ON-A1

7.decision: raise/lower the budget cap; size throughput
7.surface: rest R1a/R3a + drill L-MONEY + alert ON-A3/ON-A4

8.decision: escalate through tiers; bound human escalation
8.surface: rest R1b/R2 + drill R4b/R4c + alert ON-A1

9.surface: rest R2/R3b + drill R4d/QUEUE + alert ON-A1/ON-A2

10.surface: rest R3a/R3c + drill L-COMPOSITION + record AUDIT

rule_surface_summary.note: a rule may occupy more than one surface; the primary surface is in rules[].surface.type
